meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides house ads, classifieds rail, Google One Tap; dim or hide the home marketing sections and footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 on www.listennotes.com: the home page and /best-podcasts/ (counts from querySelectorAll). The desktop UA was redirected to a login-lite page by the site, so **no desktop DOM was captured**; the site is a responsive Tailwind app and ships the same ids on both layouts. `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` come from the one mobile home-page capture; podcast, episode and search pages were not inspected (the site's chart lists load by script and did not render for the automated browser).

- **House ads** (LIVE): `#ln_homepage_banner` (home, 1) and `#ln_side_banner` (best-podcasts, 1), both carrying `data-action="ln-ad"`, the site's own Listen411 and promo banners. Matched by that attribute.
- **Ads** (existing option, +1 rule): `#publift-web-interstitial`, the Publift interstitial mount (LIVE, 1, zero height at capture).
- **Classifieds rail** (LIVE, 2 on /best-podcasts/): `#ln-sidebar-classifieds-app` and its placeholder.
- **Google One Tap** (SOURCE: Google Identity Services markup, `#credential_picker_container`; the page carries the `#g_id_onload` config, but the prompt itself did not show in headless Chrome): hand-written fixture `real-onetap.html`.
- **Marketing sections** choice (LIVE: `#about` with three Llamacorn mascot images, `#numbers`): dim or hide the long About-Listen-Notes block under the home search.
- **Footer** (LIVE, 1): `footer[aria-labelledby="footer-heading"]`.

The three original rules were kept. Not verified: the logged-in site, podcast pages, episode pages, search results, thumbnails (artwork loads by script) and the desktop layout. The classifieds rail appears only on list pages, so `real-classifieds.html` is hand-written from the ids seen there.
